NASDAQ NEARS CORRECTION AS AI FEARS GROW

The Nasdaq 100 fell 1.6% Tuesday, putting the index on the verge of a market correction after a 10% drop from its June peak.

Investors are increasingly worried that massive AI spending by Big Tech may not deliver strong returns.

TRUMP, ZELENSKY MEET AT WHITE HOUSE

President Donald Trump and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky reportedly met at the White House on Tuesday.

The meeting had not been officially confirmed, but a White House source told reporter Emily Goodin the talks began at 9:47 a.m.
